exposure: Indication for previous cesarean delivery (non-favorable vs. favorable)
Gestational diabetes (GDM) in women with a previous cesarean delivery
cohort: Singleton pregnancies at a university hospital in Israel between 2009 and 2015, with women who had one previous cesarean delivery and GDM matched to those without GDM based on past cesarean delivery indication.
finding: Gestational diabetes significantly reduced the likelihood of attempting and achieving a vaginal delivery after a previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: GDM significantly diminished the likelihood of a trial of vaginal delivery after cesarean delivery and its subsequent success.
